reviews.title: Avoid at all cost.
reviews.text: I stopped flying with CMA several years ago due to poor service but unfortunately I had to use their services this weekend to fly back to Canada from Puerta Vallarta. I was reminded why I stopped flying with them. The planes are tiny, uncomfortable and crowded. Flights are always delayed! Due to the size of their planes sometimes your checked luggage doesn't fly with you and if you live close to your destination they send your luggage on another flight and you are forced to return to the airport hours after you have landed to retrieve your luggage. I have seen them cancel flights due to weather conditions and watch WestJet and others still fly out regardless of the conditions. Poor service, no food, no drinks, no space and unreliable.
reviews.author: John C

reviews.title: Delay, Delay, Delay, Cancel
reviews.text: First time flying with them, never ever again. Was suppose to depart at 9:05, ended up being delayed until 10:05, then 14:00 due to”volcanic ash”. Went to lunch and came back to the lounge around 12/12:30, only to find out it was delayed again to 16:45 without any notice or announcement. Asked some friends around Prince George, and looked on the Prince George airport website, only to find out it was clear blue skies with no signs of “ash”. They finally canceled it at 14:45, with no compensation. Customer representatives were nice, but had no idea what was going on and were 7/10 times on the phone. Save yourself the hassle and go with another airline.
reviews.author: Jazz Ecclez

reviews.title: CMA has the worst customer service and they are always delayed
reviews.text: 1. My flight was delayed by 5hours. They initially advised of poor weather conditions and when the weather was fine, they didn't have a plane to fly us. 2. When they finally got us in a plane, they landed us in an airport 1hr drive away from our destination and advised that we can either arrange for our own transportation at our cost or they can fly us back to Vancouver with no ITA when we can fly to our destination. 3. When we reached out to customer service, they told us that it was our decision to check in and they cannot do anything for us.
reviews.author: Girisha S

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Their website is always having problems, whether its errors without any course of action, their QR codes not scanning, and ease of use. They literally just launched an update, which doesn't even add any new functionality like adding flights to calendars, apple wallet, etc. They need to fire their developers, they have no vision.
reviews.author: Evan M

reviews.title: Worst Airline for Special Needs
reviews.text: mom was being flown to Kelowna Cancer Centre arranged by Hope Air from Prince George. No ramp was provided for my mom in a wheelchair! they lifted her or tried to lift her up 4 stairs and dropped her n the 4th! There is no excuse for this type of negligence!
reviews.author: Patty Howard

reviews.title: Avoid Central Mountain Air like a plague.
reviews.text: The plane was over an hour late to board with no info at the gate as to why. Then once boarded the plane sat on the ground for over another hour before taxiing onto the runway. At no time were the passengers informed as to what the delay cause was, or when we would be taking off. Also, none of the flight information was updated so people were left at the Kamloops terminal waiting for our arrival for several hours with no information updates. Customer service was of little help and didn’t even offer an apology let alone compensation for their lack of professionalism. I would not recommend this airline to anyone for any reason what so ever. All in all, I would have arrived at me destination faster had I driven and I wouldn’t have had people wasting hours of their life waiting at the airport.
reviews.author: Brett N

reviews.title: Joke of an airline
reviews.text: I have flown with cma twice and it’s two times too many. Both flights were delayed 2.5 hours. I wish I would have driven to my destination. The prices are comparable to larger airlines like WJ and air Canada and neither of them have given me trouble in the past. Westjet and air Canada have more comfortable, larger planes as well. If you have an option to drive or choose another airline pick one and avoid cma

reviews.title: Damaged baggage and no compensation
reviews.text: Flew with this airline recently and they damaged my $350 ski bag ripping the top zipper flap. Would not compensate me as I did not report the damage at the airport because I was already late for my connecting shuttle. Awful customer care.
reviews.author: Sam R

reviews.title: Too many delays
reviews.text: Every flight always seems to be delayed. For the same amount of time post delay I can use WestJet or Air Canada and connect in Vancouver. Price is roughly the same if not slightly more expensive with CMA. Going forward with travel to and from Prince George I'll stick with the more reliable flights.

reviews.title: The worst airline ever no respect for their employees
reviews.text: great service and great staff but terrible management and owners they have no respect for their employees and just down right terrible company to work for very low wage paid also what a joke company

reviews.title: Poor Service and Planning - Choose Pacific Coastal instead
reviews.text: I'm never booking with Central Mountain Air again. Both they and Pacific Coastal had weather advisories to Campbell River and had flights departing at the same time. Pacific Coastal said if the weather was too poor that they would go to Comox and bus us the rest of the way, whereas Central Mountain Air would fly back to Vancouver and tell us to get our own accommodation at our expense. Guess where we ended up. Go with Pacific Coastal if you have a choice...
reviews.author: Brook R

reviews.title: CMA: Connecting Hinterland to Metropolis
reviews.text: Established in 1987, CMA is a regional airline based in Smithers, BC. From 1997 to 2011, CMA functioned as one of Air Canada’s “feeder” airlines, taking passengers from smaller communities to the larger hub of Vancouver. While it hasn’t functioned under the “Air Canada connector” banner for some 8 years, CMA has nevertheless maintained its codeshare agreement with Canada’s flag carrier. As of this writing, CMA serves 16 communities in BC and Alberta – many of which are not serviced by the “big two” of Air Canada and WestJet, i.e.: Williams Lake, Quesnel and High River, for example. In this regard, CMA functions as a sort of life line for these smaller, rural areas. Unfortunately, I think this slight monopoly in some areas has resulted in CMA taking a page out of the “big two” playbook; that is to say, oftentimes their prices are on par with – and sometimes exceed – those of Air Canada or WestJet. You would think CMA, as a smaller carrier, might try to attract patrons by advertising slightly smaller airfares, but that doesn’t seem to be their MO, which is quite bamboozling. Because of that, I’ve only flown with this airline once – and that’s because it was the only direct option for my specific route. I flew with CMA from Prince George to Terrace on a rather chilly February morning. As was already alluded to above, the price was a bit “up there” for a flight barely an hour long but seeing as they’re the only game in town for such a route . . . well, you pay the piper. On the plus side, our pilots were professional and polite throughout; and our aircraft, the Beechcraft 1900D, was comfortable despite being a fairly full flight. Leg room was sufficient and the views of the mountains lovely. When we landed at YXT, it was like night and day: Crisp, clear blue skies in contrast to the snowy mess we left behind in Prince George. That said, I would fly with CMA again – specifically to ride on one of their Dornier aircraft. I only wish their prices were a bit more appealing, especially when they’re competing with the mainline carriers. If the price is virtually identical to WestJet or Air Canada, why wouldn’t I choose the larger carrier with its bigger aircraft (and loyalty programs)?
reviews.author: PookyCake

reviews.title: Short flight by professional pilots and counter staff
reviews.text: Checking in for this regional flight at Vancouver's South Terminal is so much nicer than the over-crowded and chaotic main terminal. Front counter staff were friendly and accomodating of our request to sit close to each other and behind the wing for a better view. Flight crew were welcoming and provided a brief, but thorough, safety briefing. Nice change to see the actual pilots perform their magic during the flight. Flight departed on time and our route was along the coastline, which was spectacular! Smooth flight and the Captain greased the landing (gentle landing). We really enjoyed the in-bound flight and the return flight three days later. Would definitely fly CMA again.
reviews.author: DMMEdmonton

reviews.title: Horrible Service....will never fly with them again.
reviews.text: I have started flying with CMA recently this year and I am quite disappointed with the service after a flight (9M838). We first started with a flight delay that was not communicated on the mic to the passengers. At one point the screen behind the gate had shown "departed" for our flight which caused many of us to believe we missed the flight. No communication from the team at the airport with the 1 hour delay. Once we finally boarded after the 1 hour delay, I had to listen to (as well as others on the plane) a flight attendant flirting with an old boyfriend sitting in the front. When we land, I find my luggage has been bumped to another flight (Air Canada Flight 252). There were several of us that had our luggage bumped. I also noticed that 4 hunters that were on the plane picked up 2 trolleys each of additional luggage/gear. Don't you think that the people with extra luggage/gear should have had their luggage bumped instead? In the late morning (the next day) I call the CMA phone number provided by the CMA attendant the previous night and find out it is a reservation number and not a customer service number. CMA does not have a customer service number. What airline doesn't? The reservation person on the phone (Vanessa) stated that this is not their issue now as the bags are with AirCanada and it's their responsibility. Really????....is that normal for CMA to start passing the buck already? The reality is that the flight was over booked with people and luggage and then many of us were without luggage the next day. As they do not have a phone number, all I could do is write an email.....Guess how many hours later they responded??? 2 days later was the response from a representative. Wow.....really good customer service again. Someone did end up finally calling the next day in the early afternoon after I spent 3 hours with Air Cananda and CMA reservations on the phone trying to find luggage. The flight landed at 7pm and I did not get a call until 1:30pm.....18 hours later....Is that an airliner you would fly with? Needless to say, I will never fly with that airliner again.
reviews.author: Phil W

reviews.title: Terrible airline
reviews.text: Plane was constantly delayed and take off late every stop. Attendants were rude and had very strict rules that the big airlines don't even follow. Seats are all old and falling apart.
reviews.author: ddowd

reviews.title: Central Mountain Air Flight
reviews.text: This is a great regional carrier, and their employees went of of their way to provide us with service, when our timing was extremely tight, due to a long line of people trying to clear customs in Vancouver. Great job, CMA!
reviews.author: Roger C

reviews.title: Good flight
reviews.text: Great Flight, all i want is to be safe! They only fly when its safe. I rather live then take a chance. Im prepared for a motel room if weather is bad especially in winter. Our airport has no guidance the pilot has to land the airplane without any help if worse come to worse.
reviews.author: bill182161

reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: I fly Central mountain a lot due to my geographical location. The prices are fair, and the service is always good. My last trip exceptionally so. I left my I Pad on the plane and did not realize until I had transferred flights and the plane I was on had already left. I was also unable to talk to an agent when I got home due to timing of flight. I emailed them and they got back to me promptly stating the had found my I pad, and got it flown up to me the next day. Great above and beyond customer service!
reviews.author: jode33

reviews.title: Poor customer service - delayed flights with no notice
reviews.text: If you can go on a different airline I would suggest it. Poor service, poor communications to their customers seems to be their motto. Bad experience, I would not ever recommend this airline. Especially if you need to be on time.
reviews.author: garlicspamsam

reviews.title: Constant flight delays
reviews.text: Don’t recommend this airline fly pacific coastal if you can ! Central mountain air plagued by flight delays
reviews.author: Cam

reviews.title: Diverted but not taken care of
reviews.text: Checking in at the counter , they mention not Weather advisory - therefore did not have the privilege to have my boarding pass STAMPED as a Warning (deferring any responsability from the airline to the customer) We were supposed to board at 7.30 and announcement was done at 7.50 ish that the flight would be delayed at 9 Then no notification until 8.55/9 ish when we were told that this will fly at 9.30 Worse is that when you board the plane, they are still not sure if it will be at final destination (quesnel) or perahps, re-routed to Williams Lake, but most importantly....with no Option provided by the airline to accomodate transportATION TO THE FINAL DESTINATION Come on CMA we booked a flight to Point B not point C...regardless if this is your fault or mother nature's fault, you have to better consider your customer. The plane was full therefore accomodating a Bus to transport your "loyal customer" to their final destination they have paid for is the minimum expected.....OH i forgot, is this because you are the only one flying there? Well hopefully this will change one day Not happy at all. Will not recommend. Better option is Flying to Prince georges with AC or anyone else flying there and rent a car, at least they have better options there

reviews.title: Delays and Bad Service
reviews.text: Flight attendant was only reason for anything positive about my first and last flight with this airline. I paid $259 one way from PG to Fort St John for an important business meeting; 2 hours of delays resulted in missed appointments; phoney reason of fog given by staff and yet every other aircraft was taking off and landing!
reviews.author: Michael B

reviews.title: Small but good
reviews.text: Very professional for a small regional airline Comfortable Dash 8 Dawson Creek airport is very small so don’t expect any services except a cafe and a singularly bad National Car Rental
reviews.author: William S

reviews.title: They are a small airline that treats its passengers very well
reviews.text: I have flown this air line a few times and found all the staff to always be helpful and efficient. They do their best to keep the flight on time which because of weather can sometimes be difficult. They do try to catch up if there has been a delay.
reviews.author: Ernie V

reviews.title: Absolutely NO FRILLS
reviews.text: This flight to a Northern City in a small turboprop is as just what you'd expect. Slow, noisy and bumpy and not even a pretzel. The good thing about the trip up and back is we made it. Expect nothing but a ride and you won't be disappointed.
reviews.author: LarryG135

reviews.title: Last minute added connection means 2 missed events in 1 week
reviews.text: Central Mountain Air has caused me to be late for two events in a row (two weeks in a row) after changing flight plans and adding a connection at the last minute, adding over an hour and a half. Minimal communication is given and no compensation for arriving so much later than the flight was supposed to. In flight crew was fine. Plane was a bit old but fine. Such drastic changes two weeks in a row are terrible. I even called in after the first one to see if it was going to happen with the second and there had been no connection at that time.
reviews.author: Locke12

reviews.title: Over booked flight! Not Recommended!
reviews.text: Flew from Prince George to Vancouver! Flight was over booked by 3 person and have to delate my schedule for 3 hours to take Air Canada. Not going to buy tickets from them anymore. Prefer west jet or air Canada.
reviews.author: Hubert C

reviews.title: Excellent service, fantastic airline
reviews.text: I will definitely fly Central Mountain Air again. So convenient to go from Terrace to Prince George and in no time at all. The staff including the pilots were so friendly, I can’t say enough. Small plane, with big service. I highly recommend others to try Central Mountain Air!
reviews.author: Terena S

reviews.title: Local Airlines
reviews.text: There are only 2 passenger airlines which fly in and out of Williams Lake . One is Central Mountain Air (CMA) and the other is Pacific Coastal Airlines. Both are good airlines. CMA flies in and out of the International / Main Terminal while Pacific Coastal flies in and out of the South Terminal. If you are connecting to Out-of-Province, Trans-border or International flights I suggest flying CMA. If you are flying within BC . then Pacific Coastal is a good alternative as it connects to many smaller communities. Be sure to check both airlines and PRICES.
reviews.author: cariboo99

reviews.title: Buisnesstrip
reviews.text: Small planes, short flights but clean planes. Great staff, easy to check in and board, get to chat with new with people around you on flights.
reviews.author: frankfJ7773WA

reviews.title: Flight with CMA
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to fly with Canadian Mountain Air and my experience was pleasant. The flight crew were friendly and competent. The flights were short but the service was pleasant.
reviews.author: kathylO1864MG

reviews.title: Business Trip to Edmonton
reviews.text: Very nice to have a one hour flight direct to Edmonton. Saves lots of waiting time between flights by not going thru Vancouver. Service was good.
reviews.author: WillyTRock

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Was a very nice flight from beginning to end the counter lady Donelda was very helpful and cheery! The baggage handler Darrel was very polite and the pilots did an amazing job especially considering we had a great amount of turbulence! They let us know it was going to happen and boy did it ever! But we had a pleasant trip and landed safely!
reviews.author: kimberlylU4428GB

reviews.title: Very happy with our experience
reviews.text: We had a very smooth flight. It was our first time travelling with a wheelchair. They stowed the manual wheelchair as a Sky Check item so it was ready for us to use in the Vancouver airport. The staff in the terminal & on the plane were very pleasant. We booked with this airline to connect to an Air Canada flight from Vancouver.
reviews.author: Heather A

reviews.title: good flight, not so good customer service
reviews.text: I checked in online for our flight a couple of hours before we were supposed to be at the airport, everything looked on track. When we checked our bags, we were informed that the flight would be delayed an hour as they were waiting for another flight to come in. Ok, well, delays happen. We got to Edmonton at 715pm, waited for our luggage to come, and waited, and waited. No luggage from our flight came. Information didn't know anything, no one from CMA was working, the sign on the checkin desk said "back at 645am". Phone was not being answered, said if you're calling after hours, send an email and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. Doesn't do much good when you're standing in the middle of the airport waiting. Finally, at 830pm the carousel started moving and our luggage appeared. One of our suitcases had the handle ripped completely off and a broken wheel. My husband sent an email, and I phoned CMA the next day, had to leave a message. Neither of us have heard anything from anyone. The flight itself was great. Flight crew and ground crew were great. Customer service from Admin staff sucks. If someone had showed up and said sorry, there's a problem, blah blah, it would have helped. With all the delays, we were in the airport for 6.5 hours for a 1.5 hour flight. Communication from CMA would have been nice.
reviews.author: Diane P

reviews.title: Need to communicate changes
reviews.text: Our flight was scheduled to depart at 10 a.m., but when we arrived at the airport, they told us they had changed the flight time to 11:30 a.m. An email or phone call about the change would have been helpful, as we could have stayed at home a little longer. Small crew and small plane, that allows us to fly from our small community to YVR in an hour.

reviews.title: Edmonton to Terrace November 2017
reviews.text: The flight was on schedule, the plane was clean, the service was pleasant and the staff on the ground were very helpful.

reviews.title: Excellent Staff- Flight a Little Bumpy
reviews.text: It's fantastic to be able to fly between some of the smaller BC destinations on Central Mountain Air, and the staff are very friendly and accommodating. One thing- If you're not used to flying on smaller aircraft, some of these trips can be bumpy.

reviews.title: Almost perfect

If I was to have even a relatively short extention at work, I would very likely miss my flight and there are no addition flight on the day.

reviews.title: Excellent service when we arrived at airport at the last moment!

reviews.title: I appreciate the little things in life!
reviews.text: I found the airline staff very friendly & helpful. I also appreciate that for a small town, we have an airline! And who doesn't enjoy being able to be somewhere in an hour'ish vs driving!

reviews.title: Little Airline that excels..
reviews.text: Despite the smoke in the sky from the wildfires Central Mountain Air was able to get me into Kamloops in a safe a fast manner
reviews.author: Sandra D

reviews.title: Smoke!!
reviews.text: We were supposed to travel on Greyhound and were able to get a flight at the last minute when Greyhound cancelled all bus travel in the area due to the forest fires. The cost wasn't inflated and we were not charged for our luggage. The flight was really interesting as we flew over all the fires and the smoke, what a sight. The whole flight when we passed Williams Lake became really different, lots to see and look at. Not a normal flight at all!!

Also, if you're looking for snacks on the plane, don't. Get something at the airport, Was about a 40 min flight from Vancouver to Campbell river.

reviews.text: The lady at the check in didn't find our booking for 20 minutes then had us unpack 300 grams! of weight because we had 23.4 kg instead of 23 kg. 100 g tolerance was ok.
